<<Notes on Tuning Of A Street Organ>>

Tuning a street organ requires attention to both sound quality and structural integrity. The organ must be adjusted to produce clear, resonant notes that blend well with the community. A key part of this process is ensuring the rivets are properly secured to maintain the organ’s stability. The use of tallow, a traditional material for lubrication, helps reduce friction and prolong the life of the mechanisms. Regular tuning ensures the organ remains a welcoming and functional part of the community.
